question: Who founded the Muhammdan Anglo-Oriental college in 1875 which later became Aligarh Muslim University?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Syed Ahmed Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Syed Ahmed Khan **__founded the Muhammdan Anglo-Oriental college in 1875 which later became Aligarh Muslim University.
 
• He considered competence in English and "Western sciences" necessary skills for maintaining Muslims' political influence, especially in Northern India.
 
• Mahendra Pratap Singh gave land for the university.
 
• On 9th September 1920 the Mohammedan Anglo-Oriental College became the Aligarh Muslim University.
 
• Sultan Shah Jahan Begum was the first Chancellor of the University.
 
• The work of Syed Ahmed Khan gave rise to a new generation of Muslim intellectuals and politicians who composed the Aligarh movement to secure the political future of Muslims in India.
 
• He also was a jurist for the British East India Company.
